It also fails to update `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`, and leaves a `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the tree. While the basic wiring in `messageHandler.ts` and `validation.ts` follows the right general structure, the contract and safety requirements are largely missed.
